The reading was true of its moment and wrong as a statement about the run; this round I name the queued jobs explicitly for that reason.

findings: 17 family members are still stored at this head with Go reading the list item tight and the browser spread, all DIVERGENT at the merged base too, so none is a regression. 16 are one shape: a quoted list item whose typed block ends with a QUOTE HOLDING A LIST, with the blank line above the closing fence - `> - a`, `>   :::callout{...}`, `>   > - x`, a blank line in any of its seven forms, `>   :::` - in quoted-item (7), quoted-ordered (5) and twice-quoted-item (4) holders. In all 16 the only difference is the item's spread. The folded rule reads or refuses every other member of the 1,835; this is the one body kind it does not reach, and it is the quote-inside-the-block case the carve-out has been narrowing since round 3. The 17th is not of this family: my copy of the renderer's ask-block output, where the browser does not open the outer `::::ask` at all and reads its fence lines as paragraphs. I bisected that one: it is the nested bullet list inside the ask (`- Choice1` with `  - Nested1` under it), not the four colons, which read alike on their own, and not the blank line; it is DIVERGENT at the merged base too and has nothing to do with this change.

42 documents of the family are reported by the differential as 'refused by the writer': the head reads them as the browser does, but the rendering it would store does not read back, so ParseForWrite refuses them with the generic 'the markdown the document would be stored as reads back otherwise' instead of a named reason. All 42 are the empty-item holder - `-` alone on its line, then an indented typed block - and the renderer writes the directive opener onto the item's marker line (`- :::callout{...}`), which is what does not read back. The gated form of this count, newly refused by the writer, is 0: the merged base refused all 42 by the blank-line name, so nothing is newly refused and no caller loses a document that used to be stored. What changes is the message a caller sees for that shape, from a named reason to a generic one.
